headline: Vistra Plunges 13.5% Following Texas Election and KeyBanc Downgrade
summary: Vistra plunged 13.5% after a Texas election rattled the artificial intelligence power trade and prompted a downgrade from KeyBanc.
why: Regulatory and political shifts affecting power markets impact utility providers linked to energy-intensive AI data center demand.

impacts.name: Vistra Corp.
impacts.why: Electoral outcomes and analyst downgrades directly pressure equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Political outcomes impacting power markets coupled with a broker downgrade eroded investor confidence in the company's energy demand growth assumptions.
